5051641562889.baseName: 3ft Noble Fir Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant
5051641562889.variantName: 3ft Noble Fir Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant · 本规格 / Selected: 3ft
5051641562889.sourceDescription:
If you're looking for the ideal real Christmas tree, the Noble Fir is up there with the best you can buy. Well known for it's bright green needles that display a bluish-hue with a lovely scent, providing extremely attractive foliage that won't drop it's needles. The hardy upright branches allow for even the heaviest ornaments to be easily supported. Caring for this tree doesn't require much effort, it really only needs water to keep it going, although this will be required often. Make sure when watering that the soil is not waterlogged, and do not allow the container to dry out. Once the christmas period is over, you can transfer the tree into your garden, you can leave it in the container it is supplied in but we recommend you re-pot the tree into a larger pot to accommodate it's growth. The root system that develops within the pot will allow this tree to live for years provided it is given the right level of care. Keep it outside as close to christmas as possible, and when it is time to bring the tree inside, keep it away from sources of heat such as radiators or fireplaces, these will dry the tree out and quickly cause it to drop it's needles. As we ship these staple Trees directly to you from our premesis this guarantees the life and quality of the tree you will receive as you know it won't be bashed around in travel. It's going from us, to you!
PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - GardenersDream Christmas Trees are British grown and cared for year-round by our expert team
REAL LIVING CHRISTMAS TREE - Can be placed outside in the garden after Christmas and can be used repeatedly, eliminating the need to keep buying new trees.
HARDY, ATTRACTIVE FIR - Sports impressive greenish-blue foliage, branches develop upright which helps support heavier ornaments, ideal non-needle drop variety
POT GROWN, EASY TO CARE FOR AND MAINTAIN - With regular watering and occasional feeding, these trees will last a long time. Little pruning is required, just the ocassional trim to keep it's shape
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory
